about: A device roster for a head with two machines: copy it to the head's state folder as device-roster.json (or name it in HAI_ROSTER_FILE) and edit it. One record per device. `roles` names what a device does (brain, failover, head, advisor, tolkien, acquisition); a GPU role no device claims falls to the brain. `url_setting` names the setting that holds the device's model-server address, never the address itself. `pc` numbers the physical machines. `vram_gb`, `ram_gb`, `cpu` (cores) and `gpu` describe the card, memory and processor the placement weighs; a device with a card needs all four and a `label`. Optional fields the lab's own roster also uses (its test fixture, head/tests/fixtures/lab_roster.json) are measured per machine: leave them out until you have measured yours. A clock setting for a card (`window_gpu_clock`) is the owner's own choice and nothing sets one by default.
